@echo off
cd /d D:\Kinmireva
call khoa-trello.bat
set PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8
if not exist logs mkdir logs
rem 1. chep card moi tu 6 board ETSY - toi da 10 phut
set KM_KEO_GHI=1
set KM_KEO_TRAN=600
set KM_KEO_PHUT=10
set KM_KEO_TU_NGAY=2026-08-01
rem    FoxEra 03/10: chep tu board ETSY toi het 02.10 roi TAM DUNG. Mo lai: xoa dong duoi
set KM_KEO_DEN_NGAY=2026-10-02
py -3.11 km_keo_etsy.py >> logs\km_keo_etsy-console.log 2>&1
rem 2. mau ban chay tu so don noi bo - moi ngay 1 lan, khong cham Etsy
set KM_BC_GHI=1
set KM_BC_MIN=2
py -3.11 km_keo_ban_chay.py >> logs\km_keo_ban_chay-console.log 2>&1
rem 2c. MAU THANG (km_thang 1.0): don that Shopify + so don Etsy -> KM-MAU-THANG.csv (km_duyet uu tien) + kinmireva-winners-*.json (may sinh y doc)
set KM_FEED_DIR=D:\FoxEra\ideas\signals\kinmireva
py -3.11 km_thang.py >> logs\km_thang-console.log 2>&1
rem 2b. nap listing tu CSV Etsy xuat (etsy-csv) - khong cham etsy.com, moi ngay 1 lan
set KM_NAP_GHI=1
set KM_NAP_TRAN=400
py -3.11 km_nap_shop.py >> logs\km_nap_shop-console.log 2>&1
rem 3. duyet - tu nang tran theo ton dong, toi da 45 phut, tran 1200 card/ngay
set KM_DUYET_GHI=1
set KM_DUYET_CHUYEN=1
set KM_DUYET_MODEL=claude-sonnet-4-6
set KM_DUYET_TRAN=auto
set KM_DUYET_PHUT=45
set KM_DUYET_TRAN_NGAY=1200
set KM_SKU_SAN=290729
set KM_FEED_DIR=D:\FoxEra\ideas\signals\kinmireva
py -3.11 km_duyet.py >> logs\km_duyet-console.log 2>&1
rem 3b. giao lai card Claude DAT bi ket o Cho duyet (km_duyet loi giua chung) -> Cho Upload
set KM_GL_GHI=1
py -3.11 km_giao_lai.py >> logs\km_giao_lai-console.log 2>&1
rem 4. quet don store: title/SEO/alt/category + thang gia v2 + bo compare-at cho san pham moi upload
set KM_SHOP_GHI=1
py -3.11 km_shop_sua.py >> logs\km_shop_sua-console.log 2>&1
rem 5. ornament ORN-3.1 (km_ornament): Size nho den lon, nen 1 gia tri, Ribbon 13, tag es-orn-*
set KM_ORN3_GHI=1
py -3.11 km_orn_v3.py >> logs\km_orn3-console.log 2>&1
rem 5b. bang mau xuong MP-2: doi ten mau cu ve ten xuong tren ao moi len - KHONG xoa variant
set KM_MP_GHI=1
set KM_MP_XOA=0
py -3.11 km_mau_quet.py >> logs\km_mau_quet-console.log 2>&1
rem 6. ao/mu: mau mockup len dau (variant mac dinh) - mu + 4 dong ao, moi trang thai, chua co tag mau-mac-dinh
set KM_MAU_GHI=1
set KM_MAU_TRAN=60
set KM_MAU_PHAM_VI=tat-ca
py -3.11 km_mau_mac_dinh.py >> logs\km_mau-console.log 2>&1
set KM_MAU_PHAM_VI=can-xem
py -3.11 km_mau_mac_dinh.py >> logs\km_mau-console.log 2>&1
rem 7. mu + ao: ma Easify es-mu-* / es-ao-* (vi tri + truong) cho san pham chua co es-v1
set KM_CN_GHI=1
set KM_CN_LOAI=tat-ca
set KM_CN_TRAN=60
py -3.11 km_ca_nhan.py >> logs\km_ca_nhan-console.log 2>&1
rem 8. CONG PUBLIC (FoxEra 02/10 bo nguoi duyet): draft cho-public dat het tieu chi -> ACTIVE + 4 kenh; roi hau kiem SP tu-public
rem    tat khan: tao file TAT-PUBLIC.txt trong D:\Kinmireva
set KM_CP_GHI=1
set KM_CP_TRAN=200
set KM_CP_PHAM_VI=moi
py -3.11 km_cong_public.py >> logs\km_cong_public-console.log 2>&1
set KM_CP_PHAM_VI=hau-kiem
py -3.11 km_cong_public.py >> logs\km_cong_public-console.log 2>&1
